name: button
description: Primary action button — orthogonal variant (filled/outline/ghost) × color (primary/secondary/destructive/success/warning/neutral/inherit). Sizes determine padding/typography. Supports iconOnly mode, leading/trailing icon slots, loading state. Slottable composition for asChild alongside icons. The `inherit` color reads currentColor — for icon-button affordances embedded in colored surfaces (e.g. a Banner dismiss) that must take the parent's foreground.
